title: UTILE-Pore: Deep Learning-Enabled 3D Analysis of Porous Materials in Polymer Electrolyte Membrane-Based Energy Devices

metadata.authors: A. Colliard-Granero; S. Ranieri; A. Bazylak; T. Morawietz; K. A. Friedrich; J. Jankovic; M. H. Eikerling; K. Malek; M. J. Eslamibidgoli

source_summary: A 3D deep learning framework rapidly segments catalyst and gas diffusion layers, achieving porosity accuracy within 2%, distinguishes microporous layers, automates extraction of key metrics, and provides interactive 3D visualization for on-site analysis.
abstract: Highlights 3D deep learning framework segments catalyst and gas diffusion layers in seconds. Porosity-calibrated training achieves segmentation porosity accuracy within 2%. Multiclass model distinguishes microporous layer from gas diffusion substrate. Automated pipeline extracts porosity, pore size, permeability, and tortuosity metrics. Interactive 3D visualization enables on-site exploration of segmented volumes.
